`ShapeIndex` serialization has been implemented on a new branch (`shapeindex-serialization`) branched from `main`.

### Summary of Changes

1. **`ShapeIndex` Serialization**:
   - Added [`Encode(w io.Writer) error`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-02z7zm8e/s2/shapeindex.go#L1559) and [`Decode(r io.Reader) error`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-02z7zm8e/s2/shapeindex.go#L1682) to [`ShapeIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-02z7zm8e/s2/shapeindex.go#L582).
   - If updates are pending when encoding, `applyUpdatesInternal()` is run so the full spatial cell structure is always serialized.
   - An empty index serializes to a non-empty header stream (17 bytes: version, `maxEdgesPerCell`, `nextID`, `numShapes = 0`, `numCells = 0`).
   - The spatial cell structure (`cellMap` and `cells`) is decoded and marked `fresh` so queries (`ContainsPointQuery`, `CrossingEdgeQuery`, `ShapeIndexRegion`, etc.) and iterators work immediately without requiring `Build`.

2. **Shape ID and Reference Integrity**:
   - Shape IDs are preserved across encoding so cell clipped-shape references stay valid.
   - Fixed `applyUpdatesInternal` in [`s2/shapeindex.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-02z7zm8e/s2/shapeindex.go#L854-L864) and [`updateFaceEdges`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-02z7zm8e/s2/shapeindex.go#L1219) to reference `s.nextID` rather than `s.Len()`, preventing sentinels from conflicting with active shapes when gaps exist due to shape deletions.

3. **Built-in Shape Round-Tripping**:
   - Added type tags and serialization support for all built-in [`Shape`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-02z7zm8e/s2/shape.go#L186) types:
     - [`Polygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-02z7zm8e/s2/polygon.go) (`typeTagPolygon = 1`)
     - [`Polyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-02z7zm8e/s2/polyline.go) (`typeTagPolyline = 2`)
     - [`PointVector`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-02z7zm8e/s2/point_vector.go) (`typeTagPointVector = 3`)
     - [`LaxPolyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-02z7zm8e/s2/lax_polyline.go) (`typeTagLaxPolyline = 4`)
     - [`LaxPolygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-02z7zm8e/s2/lax_polygon.go) (`typeTagLaxPolygon = 5`)
     - [`Loop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-02z7zm8e/s2/loop.go) (`typeTagLoop = 6`)
     - [`LaxLoop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-02z7zm8e/s2/lax_loop.go) (`typeTagLaxLoop = 7`)
   - Implemented `Encode` and `Decode` on [`PointVector`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-02z7zm8e/s2/point_vector.go), [`LaxPolyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-02z7zm8e/s2/lax_polyline.go), [`LaxPolygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-02z7zm8e/s2/lax_polygon.go), and [`LaxLoop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-02z7zm8e/s2/lax_loop.go).
   - Ensured zero-edge shapes (empty points, polylines, loops, polygons) and full shapes (e.g. `FullPolygon`, `FullLoop`, full `LaxPolygon`) round-trip cleanly with chain counts and dimensions preserved.

4. **Error Handling & Malformed Input Safety**:
   - Guarded all slice allocations against oversized requests (`maxEncodedShapes`, `maxEncodedCells`, `maxEncodedClippedShapes`, `maxEncodedEdgesPerClippedShape`, `maxEncodedVertices`, `maxEncodedLoops`).
   - Slices are allocated with small initial capacities and grown dynamically to prevent OOM on truncated streams claiming large counts.
   - Strict validation checks on CellID validity, ordering, non-existent shape references, coordinate corruptions (`NaN`/`Inf`), and corrupted boolean values.
   - Protected against panics via recover boundary returning clean errors.

5. **Tests**:
   - Added unit and fuzz/malformation tests in [`s2/shapeindex_encode_test.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-02z7zm8e/s2/shapeindex_encode_test.go).
   - All tests pass cleanly under `go test ./...` and `go test -race ./...`.
